youtube.title: 🔍 Tracked 740 Job Offers Without Spreadsheets?
youtube.description: You're wasting months tracking job applications in spreadsheets. But what if you didn't have to? Meet Career-Ops—a game-changer in the job search scene. This open-source AI system, boasting 45,000 stars, transforms Claude into your personal recruiter. It scans 45 company portals for new roles and even evaluates job fit by scoring roles from A to F. Plug in a job URL, and it generates an ATS-optimized PDF tailored for that position. No more manually copying resumes into forms! The creator used this system to evaluate 740 job listings and landed a Head of Applied AI role by automating the entire process. Stop letting companies filter you with AI while you click manually. Comment CAREER and I'll send you the setup guide!

linkedin.text:
You're wasting months tracking job applications in spreadsheets. But what if you didn't have to?

I stumbled upon this developer who manually tracked 740 offers before deciding enough was enough.

They built Career-Ops, an AI system that turns Claude into a personal recruiter. It's open-source with 45,000 stars and automates the tedious parts of job hunting. Imagine pasting a job URL and getting a tailored resume spat out for you! This system scans 45 company portals, evaluates job fits, and generates ATS-friendly PDFs.

The creator evaluated 740 listings with it and landed a Head of Applied AI role. Talk about leveling the playing field!

Are you still doing this manually? Comment below and let's chat!

#AI #JobSearch #CareerOps #Automation #OpenSource
